viewing_check: Armitage estimate $10-20 (8 Nov; live bid not shown on the page, check on the day). BEST LOT in this part. If it is a real Japanese glass float of 25-30 cm, Terapeak shows A$106-268 for singles of 8-11 inches. Check at viewing: tap it (glass rings, plastic thuds), look for a seam, bubbles or a seal button, and whether the net is complete. Large pale/white floats are less sought than blue/green. Estimate $10-20 is far under comps if genuine. Prices are within 3 years and roughly steady.
